description: Descriptive statistics + regression — Descriptive statistics for a list of numbers: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min/max, range, sample and population variance/stdev, coefficient of variation, standard error, 95% t-interval for the mean, geometric mean, quartiles/IQR, percentiles, skewness, excess kurtosis (Excel SKEW/KURT definitions), Tukey outliers and a histogram. Add y= (same count) for Pearson r, R squared, Spearman rho and least-squares regression with slope t-stat and p-value. Params: data= comma-separated numbers (required, max 20000); optional y=, p= percentile list (e.g. 10,50,90), bins=. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_stats
